nexus.name: Download tokens from the FA Nexus catalog
nexus.hint: Summoned creatures get a token from FA Nexus: files you already downloaded are always used; with this option on, a matching free token is also downloaded from the Nexus catalog (needs FA Nexus synced). Off by default.

formToken.name: Token changes with a battle form
formToken.hint: While a battle form effect is active (Animal Form, Dragon Form, Devil Form, Pest Form, etc.) the token image comes from FA Nexus: files you already downloaded are always used; with this option on, a matching free token is also downloaded. When the effect ends the image reverts by itself. Also controls the tree image of Protector Tree and Timber Sentinel (a random tree from FA assets). On by default.
formToken.title: Creature form
formToken.prompt: {name}: choose a creature for the token
